Delta checkpoints could affect the at-rest artifact shape (DBK3 metadata, AAD, lookup tags, TTL, file counts) tracked by T-041's detection_hint. Whether delta files keep HMAC-only names, no prompt-derived metadata beyond lookupTag, salt scoping, and per-file GCM authentication, and whether chain/parent references in deltas leak prefix structure or enable partial replay, cannot be verified from this evidence. This is an unverified contract, not a finding. The next pass should review SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift, SSDBlockStore.swift, SSDLookupKeys.swift and SSDPrefixCache.swift if they are part of the PR, and confirm that the T-041 text on at-rest metadata still holds.
